items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-13
items.q: Like I say, I wasn't a DD.

ctx.x: Once again, I can't ask you. I don't know... Did they tend to have a lot of colored bands? I would say without knowing, I would say that there was no... that there were considerable colored bands used.
What about... have Blanco such as debutante parties? Would they have a jazz band at a debutante party? I can't answer that question. Like I say, I wasn't a DD.

Alright, well, you say... You said there comes somebody who might be able to answer your question. Polly? Yeah. This is Mr. Hilliard, my brother-in-law, Mr. LeBuff, Mr. Hilliard. Now we're coming in and being a good for me. He said they do a full follow. Did they do a little bit like B4? No. Okay, more than I did.
